articles.title: ISRO shifts gears: Pvt sector to take lead in launch vehicle manufacturing
articles.summary: ISRO is strategically refocusing on advanced research, frontier technologies, and ambitious space missions. This shift will enable private companies and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs) to manage launch vehicle manufacturing and operational scaling. This move aims to accelerate India's space program by leveraging private sector capabilities while allowing ISRO to concentrate on groundbreaking innovations and high-impact projects, crucial for national scientific and technological advancement.

articles.title: Raksha Mantri and West Bengal Chief Minister carry out Bhumi Pujan for five expansion projects of GRSE & YIL virtually from Kolkata
articles.summary: India's Ministry of Defence is launching projects worth approximately Rs 3,500 crore to significantly bolster the nation's shipbuilding, ship repair, metallurgical, and production capabilities. This substantial investment aims to strengthen India's indigenous defence industrial base, promoting crucial self-reliance and enhancing national security. These initiatives are vital for modernizing armed forces and supporting strategic naval operations.

articles.title: Lanterns: How the Green Lantern Connects to Superman & DCU
articles.summary: HBO Max is launching a new series, 'Lanterns,' set to bring the Green Lantern Corps to the forefront of the DC Universe. This development signals a bright future for the iconic intergalactic defence force within the franchise, focusing on their adventures and expanding their presence in the DC storyline. The show aims to explore new aspects of the corps and its mission.

articles.title: PLA Navy commissions new Type 054A frigate as cost-effective platform continues production, upgrade
articles.summary: Chinese state media (Global Times) released footage showcasing the Type 054A guided missile frigate Ningde's latest training exercises. This highlights China's continuous naval modernization and operational readiness. For SSB aspirants, noting such global defence advancements, particularly concerning advanced frigates like the Type 054A, is crucial for enhancing general awareness and strategic understanding of maritime power.

articles.title: Space, AI and other tech integration to shape a nation's geopolitical future: Minister Shekhawat
articles.summary: Union Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat emphasized the crucial convergence of advanced technologies: space tech, AI, quantum computing, robotics, semiconductors, and high-performance computing. He highlighted their collective potential to drive India's future growth, foster innovation, and enhance strategic capabilities across diverse sectors, underscoring the nation's commitment to technological advancement.

articles.title: Traitors 2: Parul Gulati shares cryptic post after her eviction; Krystle D’Souza says, 'Valid points le aati na'

articles.title: Massive Burmese python seized at Coney Island after man showed illegal pet snake to crowd
articles.summary: A massive Burmese python was recently seized at Coney Island after its owner publicly displayed the illegal pet snake to a crowd. Authorities intervened to confiscate the large reptile, addressing concerns over public safety and illegal exotic animal possession. The incident highlights the importance of adhering to wildlife regulations and responsible pet ownership in urban settings.
